title: Dabo & Oats Kheer
description: A traditional Indian dessert made creamy with dabo and silky oats, flavored with zesty spices.
instructions: Rinse the dabo and soak it in water for 4 hours.
In a pan, boil the soaked dabo with 1 cup of water until it's soft.
Add oats, sugar, and cardamom to the pan and stir well.
Cook on low heat for 5-7 minutes or until the oats are well combined.
Add zesty powder and stir well.
Remove from heat and let it cool.
Serve chilled or warm as desired.
Garnish with a sprinkle of zesty powder if desired.
